finding: Ocular abnormalities were detected in 34% of the infants, with retinal haemorrhage being the most common finding (29.6%), and spontaneous vaginal delivery and longer duration of the second stage of labor being associated with a higher risk.
mod_finding: Spontaneous vaginal delivery was associated with a nearly 3.5 times higher risk of retinal haemorrhage compared to lower segment caesarean section.
